verdict.rationale: The only quantization evidence is LocalAI running a GGUF model with Q8_0 quantization pulled from Hugging Face, plus mentions of ggml/gguf models. That shows it loads quantized GGUF models, but none of the formats the story names are documented. Missing for 10: documented support for FP8, INT4, GPTQ and AWQ models, a list of supported quantization formats per backend, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can load models quantized in formats like FP8, INT4, GPTQ, or AWQ

citations.quote: the autoparser detects the tool call format for any ggml/gguf model that was trained with tool support
